secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Supabase project URL. Without it the app uses its built-in local-storage fallback instead of a real project.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Supabase anon / publishable key for the project above.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Supabase service-role key, used by the Streamtape mapping endpoints.

secrets.name: STREAMTAPE_LOGIN
secrets.description: Optional. Streamtape API login (streamtape.com account settings) for the download endpoints.

secrets.name: STREAMTAPE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Streamtape API key for the download endpoints.
